name: Tops Packaging Solutions
old_description: To become the leading provider of innovative, sustainable, and high-quality packaging solutions across the United States. We aim to set new standards in the industry by delivering excellence in service, building lasting partnerships, and empowering businesses with reliable, eco-friendly packaging that makes a difference.
about:
Tops Packaging Solutions operates from Dowelltown, Tennessee, as a wholly-owned U.S. wholesale disposable packaging company. The business began with a focus on plastic food packaging and has accumulated over ten years of experience serving supermarkets and global retail brands.

The company manufactures a range of foodservice packaging including cold drink cups, coffee cups, clamshell containers, meat trays, spoons, and plates. Production takes place in a 10,000-square-meter dust-free workshop equipped with automatic production lines, supported by a workforce of 175 employees, five senior managers, and a fleet of more than 80 delivery vehicles. The company states it can fulfill orders ranging from 1,000 to one million units.

Customers include supermarkets, global retail chains, restaurants, food trucks, catering operations, and event planners. The company highlights its work with supermarkets and global retail brands, and its products are used for meal prep, takeout, catering, parties, weddings, and outdoor activities.

Tops Packaging Solutions emphasizes customization services with confidentiality, a one-stop service model backed by over a decade of industry experience, and an in-house logistics department that manages delivery planning and customs clearance. All food-contact products are certified compliant with U.S. FDA guidelines, and the company pledges to replace any product that does not meet standards.
